sections.text:
Jesus, son of Mary, peace be upon him, is a prophet, one of the most powerful of the messengers. God created him with the word “Be” in the womb of his mother, the Virgin Mary, without a father, to be a major miracle for the children of Israel, demonstrating the power of the Creator.

When Mary gave birth to him in a secluded place, she faced her people’s disapproval and false accusations, so she pointed to her infant in the cradle to answer them!
They were amazed, saying: How can we talk to someone who was a boy in the cradle? Then Jesus, as an infant, spoke God’s command and said: “I am a servant of God. He gave me the Scripture and made me a prophet.”

Jesus grew up and God sent him to the children of Israel to return them to the pure monotheism that Moses brought, and to ease some of the restrictions that were imposed on them because of their sins.

God gave Jesus amazing miracles to challenge his people who excelled in medicine and treating incurable diseases.

He used to wipe his hand over the blind man (blind from birth) and the leper (who had a serious skin disease), and he would heal them, God willing, and sight would be restored to those who had lost it, and health would return to the sick.

He used to make the shape of a bird out of clay, then blow on it, and it became a real, vibrant bird that could fly, God willing!
He would revive the dead from their graves, God willing. He would stand in front of the grave and call out to the dead, and he would come out alive and walking on his feet.

He also used to tell people what to eat, what to save, and what to hide in their homes without him seeing them, so that they would know that he was a sent prophet.

God sent down to him the book “The Gospel” as light and guidance, and it contains eloquent sermons and wisdom calling for asceticism in this world and love of the afterlife.

A small group of people called the “disciples” believed in Jesus, and they were his close companions who believed him and supported him, and asked him one day for God to send down to them a “table from heaven.”

Their purpose at the table was to eat from it and reassure their hearts, so Jesus called on his Lord, and a great table full of food was presented as a wonderful miracle and honor to them.

But the priests and rabbis of the Children of Israel felt the threat to their positions and material gains due to the spread of Jesus’ call and the people’s rally around him and their love for him.

The priests hatched a malicious plot, accused him of blasphemy and witchcraft, and denounced him to the Roman governor that he was inciting revolution, so that they could imprison him and kill him.

They conspired to crucify and kill him, and bought the trust of one of his traitorous companions (Judas Iscariot) to show them his secret location in exchange for some dirhams.

But God Almighty saved his prophet and protected him from their deception, so he cast the likeness of Jesus on that traitorous man who guided them to him.

The soldiers caught the similar man and crucified him, thinking that he was Jesus, son of Mary, while divine power intervened directly to save him.

God raised Jesus, peace be upon him, to Him alive in heaven, with his body and soul, and he was not killed or crucified as they claimed.

Jesus, peace be upon him, will descend at the end of time, as one of the signs of the Great Hour, to be a just arbiter and a just Imam.

Jesus will descend in Damascus, kill the evil Antichrist, break the cross to reveal the truth, and spread justice and peace throughout the earth so that people and animals will be safe.
